fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. IN or DE
fields.label: Country Code
fields.name: country_code

fields.description: A payment gateway plugin's name, or Manual or Cash on Delivery
fields.label: Gateway
fields.name: gateway

fields.description: Shown to customers at checkout
fields.label: Label
fields.name: label

fields.description: Bank or cash account the payments are booked to (empty: the company's default bank account)
fields.label: Payment Account
fields.name: payment_account

fields.description: Unpaid payment requests expire after this many minutes; 0 = never
fields.label: Expiry Minutes
fields.name: expiry_minutes

fields.description: Shown to the customer after checkout, e.g. bank transfer details
fields.label: Instructions
fields.name: instructions

fields.description: Currency of the storefront; prices come from the price list (read as company-currency prices) and are converted at the exchange rate
fields.label: Currency
fields.name: currency

fields.description: Sales taxes of web carts and orders (empty: the company's default sales template)
fields.label: Tax Template
fields.name: tax_template

fields.description: Catalog prices include tax
fields.label: Display Prices With Tax
fields.name: display_prices_with_tax

fields.description: Warehouses whose stock can be sold online (empty: every warehouse of the company)
fields.label: Warehouses
fields.name: warehouses

fields.description: Warehouse set on web order lines
fields.label: Fulfilment Warehouse
fields.name: fulfilment_warehouse

fields.description: Refuse quantities beyond the available stock of stock items
fields.label: Enforce Stock
fields.name: enforce_stock

fields.description: Show available quantities to customers (otherwise only in stock / out of stock)
fields.label: Show Stock Quantity
fields.name: show_stock_quantity

fields.description: Group of customers created by web checkouts
fields.label: Default Customer Group
fields.name: default_customer_group

fields.description: Non-stock service item that carries shipping charges on carts, orders and invoices
fields.label: Shipping Item
fields.name: shipping_item

fields.description: Countries the store ships to (empty: every country)
fields.label: Allowed Countries
fields.name: allowed_countries

fields.description: Customers must accept these terms at checkout
fields.label: Terms Page
fields.name: terms_url

fields.description: Payment return addresses must start with it
fields.label: Storefront URL
fields.name: store_url

fields.description: The stored value the shop takes at checkout and sells as gift cards (an item that names it); empty: no gift cards
fields.label: Gift Cards
fields.name: gift_card_kind

fields.description: The languages the storefront's words come in, separated by commas, the first the default: en, hi, ar. A visitor gets the one they ask for (?lang=, else the browser's), else the first. Words for each: Storefront Words. Empty: English
fields.label: Languages Offered
fields.name: store_languages

fields.description: The channel web carts and orders name, as promotions' Channels list it (empty: Web Shop)
fields.label: Sales Channel
fields.name: sales_channel

fields.description: Cancel a web order when its payment request expires unpaid, releasing its reserved stock
fields.label: Cancel Unpaid Orders
fields.name: cancel_unpaid_orders

fields.description: After an order is placed, a shopper may cancel it themselves from the link in their confirmation, while it has not shipped: 0 = not at all
fields.label: Shoppers May Cancel for (Hours)
fields.name: cancel_window_hours

fields.description: Automatic: what was paid goes back at once; Desk Approves: the refund waits for a person
fields.label: Refund of a Cancellation
fields.name: cancel_refund

fields.description: After the goods were delivered a shopper may ask to send them back, from the same link: 0 = not at all. The desk approves or declines
fields.label: Shoppers May Ask to Return for (Days)
fields.name: return_window_days

fields.description: Kept from what a return credits, per cent of the goods' price
fields.label: Restocking Fee
fields.name: restocking_fee_percent

fields.description: What a carrier says when a parcel is out for delivery, in its own words, separated by commas (as its tracking reports them): the shopper is then told. Empty: not told
fields.label: Carrier Words for Out for Delivery
fields.name: out_for_delivery_words

fields.default: You can cancel this order within {hours} hours of placing it, while it has not shipped. Goods can be sent back within {days} days of delivery. Keeping {fee}% of the goods' price as a restocking fee; return shipping is paid by the {shipping}; the refund goes to {refund}.
fields.description: Said on the page a shopper's link opens, under their order. {hours}, {days}, {fee}, {shipping} and {refund} are the settings above; empty: nothing is said
fields.label: Words on the Shopper's Page
fields.name: after_sales_text

fields.description: How many times one mail may go to the same order in a day, the first one among them: the desk's Send Mail Again stops there
fields.label: Same Mail to One Order at Most (a Day)
fields.name: resend_per_day

fields.description: The stored value a return is refunded as when the store refunds to store credit; empty: back to the payment
fields.label: Store Credit
fields.name: store_credit_kind
